statement: Stable blowup for the defocusing Schrödinger equation. For a sufficiently large odd nonlinearity power, constructs a nonempty open set of initial data in $`H^k(\mathbb T^{12})`$, with k > 8, whose solutions of the scalar defocusing nonlinear Schrödinger equation blow up in finite time. Thus finite-time blowup is stable under Sobolev perturbations in this supercritical regime.
